title: Play AC Online translations file
description: The text of a mod's other files in another language. content.translations names a folder of <lang>.json files: de, es, fr and it. English is the text in the mod's own files, so the folder holds no en.json. Each file is one object of key to text. A key is the path of a text: mod/name, mod/description, settings/<name>/label, settings/<name>/description, items/<id>/name, shops/flower/name, shops/flower/greeting, shops/flower/stock_line, letters/<id>/header, letters/<id>/body, letters/<id>/footer, letters/<id>/sender, calendar/<id>/board, calendar/<id>/talk/<n> and talk/<pool>/<line>. <n>, <pool> and <line> count from 1 in the order of the file. A key must name a text the mod has. Its text follows the rule of the text it replaces: the same length, the same lines and the same characters. A letter and a board notice stay plain US keyboard characters in every language. The game shows a text in its own language when the file for that language has the key. It shows the English text when it does not. This is decided for each text alone. A file cannot carry a $schema key, because every key is a text. Point your editor at translations.schema.json in its settings instead. Generated from the mod API spec (https://playaconline.com/schemas/api.json). Do not edit by hand. Reference: https://playaconline.com/modding/reference/files/

additionalProperties.description: The text in this file's language. It follows the rule of the text its key names.
